name: Xin Na (纳鑫)
description:
**Biography:** I currently work as a research assistant in the [Systems and Ubiquitous Networking (SUN) group](http://tns.thss.tsinghua.edu.cn/sun/) at Tsinghua University. Previously, I received my Ph.D. and Bachelor's degree from [School of Software, Tsinghua University](https://www.thss.tsinghua.edu.cn/), under the supervision of [Prof. Yuan He](https://tns.thss.tsinghua.edu.cn/sun/members/YuanHe/). My CV is available here.
**Research Interests:** Wireless Networking, Low power IoT, Wireless Sensing, Cross-technology Communication.
